text:
Lina Park: Quick idea 10am sync? want to run a tiny PLG test: 12-min microwebinar + tiered free credits to improve onboarding completion and prompt-template usage.
Theo Grant: short and sharp. what's the measurable hypothesis?
Lina Park: hypothesis: webinar exposure -> higher intent signals so we can highlight 3 high-value prompt templates in onboarding -> lift in week-1 retention and template usage. credits reduce friction.
Rina Shah: propose 3-arm randomized test, N=600: (A) webinar + $15 credit, (B) $15 credit only, (C) baseline. 2-week run.
Oscar Kim: routing question  which signups get webinar invites vs immediate credits? also need cap on webinar slots.
Theo Grant: rule idea: utm_campaign=webinar -> auto webinar arm; inbound organic -> random assign to B or C unless they click "Join webinar" CTA.
Rina Shah: cap webinar invites at 350/week, overflow -> waitlist + auto $5 consolation credit.
Lina Park: can product show a curated prompt pack immediately post-signup for webinar arm? that could be the treatment.
Oscar Kim: yes, onboarding supports feature flags. I'll add flag `experiments/micro_webinar_pack_v1`. will canary to 50 users.
Theo Grant: tracking: events = webinar_invited, webinar_rsvp, webinar_attended, prompt_pack_shown, prompt_template_selected, credit_redeemed.
Rina Shah: email cadence for webinar arm: invite, -48h reminder, -2h reminder, replay link + nudge to use templates.
Lina Park: timeline? want landing + creative + email flows done by Tue so we can launch Wed.
Oscar Kim: deploy-bot: create flag `experiments/micro_webinar_pack_v1` with canary=50
deploy-bot: flag created: experiments/micro_webinar_pack_v1 (canary=50) :white_check_mark:
Theo Grant: I'll wire analytics dashboard and set conversions: week1_active, prompt_template_use_pct, avg_spend_30d.
Rina Shah: experiment config snippet below, please ack with :thumbsup: if ready.
```yaml
experiment_id: mw_webinar_194322
cohort_size: 600
arms:
  - name: webinar_plus_credit
    credit_usd: 15
    webinar_invite: true
  - name: credit_only
    credit_usd: 15
    webinar_invite: false
  - name: control
    credit_usd: 0
    webinar_invite: false
metrics:
  - week1_retention
  - prompt_template_selection_rate
  - credit_redeemed_rate
traffic_rules:
  - if: utm_campaign==webinar -> assign:webinar_plus_credit
  - else: random_assign(credit_only, control)
```
Lina Park: owners: landing & creative = Rina, emails = Lina, flag + rollout = Oscar, analytics = Theo, credits ops = finance-ops.
Theo Grant: noted. I'll add event names to tracking plan and Slack alert for early signal.
Rina Shah: will prepare landing copy + CTAs. keeping copy short: "12-min intro + $15 to try prompts".
Lina Park: sounds good. final ask: keep cohort small and watch for any promo code stacking. finance-ops pls confirm credits can be provisioned.
Lina Park: if no objections I'll schedule a 10-min planning tomorrow to lock creatives. :rocket:
